# Visible mock OAuth labels need matching control IDs

The test page makes state a visible readonly text field and adds labels for screenshot clarity. The labels use for values such as state, while the inputs supply name but no matching id. That does not provide explicit label/control association. Add matching IDs when that association is intended. Keep this test-fixture source finding separate from any claim about production authentication or measured accessibility.

Scope: OAuth browser-test form markup.
